desc: Success Rate — 1st down gain ≥40% of distance, 2nd down ≥50%, 3rd+ down ≥10 yds. 1st–3rd down plays only. The methodical engine that feeds everything downstream. Weight 0.34.
label: Off SR

desc: Expected Points Added per play (CFBD play PPA, averaged over the team's offensive plays). Weight 0.20.
label: Off PPA

desc: Explosiveness — share of offensive plays gaining ≥20 yards. The second, independent route to the red zone. Weight 0.10.
label: Off Exp

desc: Share of drives that entered the opponent's red zone — the middle link: SR -> arrival -> RZ TD% -> TD%. Weight 0.06.
label: Off RZ arrival

desc: Touchdown rate on the team's drives that entered the opponent's red zone — the finishing link. Weight 0.05.
label: Off RZ TD%

desc: Share of offensive drives ending in a touchdown. ≈ arrival × RZ TD%; the end of the scoring chain. Weight 0.12.
label: Off TD%

desc: Share of offensive drives ending in a field goal — drive-death efficiency; the symptom when arrival stalls. Weight 0.03.
label: Off FG%

desc: Turnovers given away per game (INTs + lost fumbles). Lower = better; z and percentile are inverted so higher = better. Weight 0.05.
label: Off TOs (inv)

desc: Aggression Rate — go-for-it rate × first-down conversion (rewards aggressive 4th downs that work). Weight 0.05.
label: Off AR

desc: Opponents' Success Rate against this defense (same SR definition). Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.34.
label: Def SR allowed

desc: Opponents' PPA per play against this defense. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.20.
label: Def PPA allowed

desc: Share of opponent plays of ≥20 yards against this defense. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.10.
label: Def Exp allowed

desc: Share of opponent drives entering OUR red zone. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.06.
label: Def opp RZ arrival

desc: Opponents' TD rate on drives that reached our red zone — the red-zone wall. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.05.
label: Def opp RZ TD%

desc: Share of opponent drives ending in a TD. Lower = better; z inverted. Weight 0.05.
label: Def opp TD%

desc: Havoc rate — share of opponent plays that are sacks or losses of ≥4 yards. Feeds takeaways and big-play prevention. Weight 0.12.
label: Def Havoc

desc: Stuff rate — share of non-sack opponent runs/plays losing ≥2 yards. Weight 0.05.
label: Def Stuff

desc: Takeaways per game (interceptions + fumbles recovered). Weight 0.08.
label: Def TOs

desc: Opponents' Aggression Rate against this defense. Weight 0.00 (no effect on the composite).
label: Def AR allowed
